name: Emergency Contact NFC Tag
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from a combination of 3 mm wood and 3 mm acrylic layers, creating a durable and eye-catching layered design.
    - Built-in NFC tag chip securely embedded inside the product for quick contactless information access.
    - Comes with a sturdy metal wire ring (available in black or silver) for easy attachment to backpacks, luggage, handbags, pet carriers, keychains, and more.
    - Available in 2-layer and 3-layer construction options for added depth and personalization.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    Available in multiple sizes:
    - Tag Sizes:

        1.58 x 2.36 in  ~ 4 × 6 cm
       3 × 3 in  ~ 7.62 × 7.62 cm
       4 × 4 in  ~ 10.16 × 10.16 cm
       5 × 5 in  ~ 12.7 × 12.7 cm
      - Wire Ring Dimensions:
       Expanded Length: 155 mm
       Closure Diameter: 50 mm
       Wire Thickness: 2 mm
       📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as        sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors, sharp details, and excellent image clarity.
    - Supports double-sided printing.
    - UV-printed designs are durable, scratch-resistant, and fade-resistant for long-lasting use.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
    - Avoid prolonged exposure to water, excessive moisture, or direct sunlight.
    - Do not bend, drop, or apply excessive pressure to the NFC tag.
    - Keep away from high heat sources and harsh chemicals.
    - Test NFC functionality periodically to ensure stored information remains accessible.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Stores emergency contact information through an integrated NFC chip that can be accessed by simply tapping a compatible smartphone.
    - Ideal for children, students, seniors, travelers, pets, and individuals with medical conditions or special care needs.
    - Can be attached to backpacks, school bags, luggage, pet collars, diaper bags, sports bags, and everyday carry items.
    - Provides a quick and convenient way for others to access important contact details during emergencies.
    - Personalized design helps users easily identify their belongings while adding a unique decorative touch.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A practical and thoughtful gift suitable for people of all ages.
    - Perfect for: Back-to-school season, Birthdays, Christmas, Baby showers, Family gatherings, Travel gifts, Pet owner gifts, Housewarming celebrations
    - Any special occasion where safety, personalization, and convenience are valued.
    - The personalized design and smart NFC functionality make this product both meaningful and useful for everyday life.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Emergency Contact NFC Tag

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
